name: E36
_about: E36 cluster, generated by tools/gen_e36.py (edit that and regenerate): the BMW E36 328i cluster of the 90s, traced off face-on photos at true proportions. The EU face (km/h, L/100km) with metric units, the US face (MPH, MPG) with US units; with the redline at 7000 or 7500 (the 0 .. 8 rev counter) the M3's faces: red needles, a 280 km/h or 170 MPH speedometer, the /M badge, an oil temperature gauge for the economy gauge. One e36dash shader draws the face, dials, ticks, zones and needles; the printed figures are text widgets. Lamps are never lit (the app cannot read them); BMW draws its own turn arrows over the cluster. The warning-light strips cover BMW's bottom row but for holes where its range, drive mode, gear letter and electric range show; the clock and outside temperature are on the LCD's second row. Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
